_comment: Machine-readable advisory and lifecycle data consumed by scripts/check-php-version.py. Update this file (and php2shell-advisories.md / php-supported-versions.md) when php.net publishes new releases. Never edit values without a primary source.

advisories.title: RCE via OOM corruption
